Messages.Author: Jan Willem Wijsman
Messages.Body:
Hi there, I was wondering if it is possible to play taste of vitae
before you decapitate a vampire. Second, if a vampire plays thoughts
betrayed or hidden lurker and the opposing vampire has a .44 magnum, can
he/she use the maneuver of that weapon (although he/she can't shoot with
it)?
Thanks again, jw.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jan Willem Wijsman wrote:
>
> Hi there, I was wondering if it is possible to play taste of vitae
> before you decapitate a vampire. Second, if a vampire plays thoughts

Yes.

> betrayed or hidden lurker and the opposing vampire has a .44 magnum, can
> he/she use the maneuver of that weapon (although he/she can't shoot with
> it)?

Thought's betrayed only prevents the opposing minion from player strike
cards, not from striking with a weapon. The minion could still maneuver
with (and subsequently strike with) that weapon.

For Hidden Lurker: no, since using that maneuver would require the minion
to commit to a strike that he cannot perform.

Messages.Author: Richard Zopf
Messages.Body:
Jan Willem Wijsman wrote in message <37BD1E...@planet.nl>...

>Hi there, I was wondering if it is possible to play taste of vitae
>before you decapitate a vampire.

Yes.

>Second, if a vampire plays thoughts

>betrayed or hidden lurker and the opposing vampire has a .44 magnum, can
>he/she use the maneuver of that weapon (although he/she can't shoot with
>it)?

Yes. Note, they can use the strike provided by the gun under Thoughts
Betrayed. TB prohibits playing strike _cards_. A Gun on a vamp is a
resourse in play, and is thus allowed as a strike option.

Regards,
